$comment: Knowledge Engine — KB ingest manifest (the plan-shaped ingestion contract from knowledge-foundation CONTRACTS.md §4.1 / KNOWLEDGE-ARCHITECTURE.md §4.1). A manifest is DATA: reviewable, diffable, and the only way det kb ingest reads anything. Paths are never absolute owner paths: each input names a rootAlias resolved per run via --root alias=path (or DET_KB_ROOT_<ALIAS>) plus an alias-relative path, or a manifest-relative path with no alias. denyGlobs may ADD to the structural baseline deny-set (auth.json, app/etc/env.php, .env*, *credentials*, *.pem, *.key, var/**, generated/**, pub/media/**, *.sql.gz, *.dump*, **/node_modules/**) — profiles may add, never remove.
title: Knowledge Engine — KB ingest manifest

id.$comment: Platform family the KB-1 records describe, e.g. 'magento'. A non-Magento manifest emits identical shapes.

visibilityPolicy.$comment: example-only (default): KB-3 records with visibility != example are rejected — private material cannot enter the store this manifest feeds. 'any' is for local protected stores outside the public repository.

capabilityRegistry.$comment: A det inspect CapabilityRegistry payload (issue #9 contract) bridged read-only into KB-1 records. The registry file is the sole ingest input — the bridge never opens the platform tree.

uiInventory.$comment: A KB-2 metadata-only component inventory (array of kb-ui-component records). Manifest-driven: no source-tree parsing, no licensed package reads.

projectRecords.$comment: One or more KB-3 record files (JSON array or JSONL), one file per project partition.

relations.$comment: A relation-records file (JSON array or JSONL) validated against the store-wide endpoint graph.

denyGlobs.$comment: ADDED to the structural baseline (never replaces it). Glob syntax: ** crosses directories, * stays in one segment, ? matches one character. Denials are recorded as DENIED_PATH_SKIPPED diagnostics — fail-open per file, fail-closed per run.

path.$comment: Relative to rootAlias when rootAlias is set, otherwise relative to the manifest file's own directory. Never absolute, never traversal.

rootAlias.$comment: Resolved per run: --root <alias>=<absolute-path> (repeatable) > DET_KB_ROOT_<ALIAS> env. No default, no owner path inside this manifest — unresolvable aliases fail closed with ROOT_ALIAS_NOT_RESOLVED.
